title: Looks pretty. Completely not functional
text: Looks pretty. Completely not functional. I have the tourquoise pitcher. It has a layer of colored plastic on the outside. Looks pretty. Completely not functional. I fill it in the sink and water gets trapped between the two layers so when I tip it to pour water leaks out from between. Also since it's impossible to clean between the layers, the water that doesn't leak out just sits there and gets mildewy and gross! Disgusting! Get one that doesn't have the layered plastic and you'll love it.

description: Drink healthier, great-tasting tap water with this BPA free Brita 10 cup water pitcher. This orange Brita pitcher has an ergonomic design which makes pouring easy. With the flip top lid, refilling is a breeze and just a glance at the electronic filter indicator lets you know when it is time to change the Brita replacement filter. This large water pitcher comes with 1 water filter, which should be changed every 40 gallons or about 2 months for best results. Start drinking healthier, great tasting water with Brita today.

Rehydrate with a large-size pitcher in a shade of green as refreshing as the water contained within it. You'll enjoy great-tasting, cleaner water for pennies per gallon. BPA-free, the Brita Grand Water Filter Pitcher reduces copper, mercury and cadmium that can be found in tap water. It also decreases the taste of zinc and both the taste and odor of chlorine. For optimal performance, the electronic indicator lets you know when it's time to change the filter. Ergonomically designed, this oval-shape water pitcher features a flip-top lid that makes refilling a breeze and a comfort grip handle for easier pouring. The 10-cup capacity is perfect for families, sports teams and offices. What's more, you'll cut down on plastic waste since one water filter can replace up to 300 standard 16.9-ounce water bottles. Get great taste, less waste and more savings from Brita.
